{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales_df['order_status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_revenue)"}
